steps.intro: Welcome to the GAFS A-Watch Teacher portal.
steps.login: Sign in with your teacher account.
steps.dashboard: Your dashboard shows session statistics and recent attendance activity.
steps.sessions.view: The Sessions page lists all your class sessions.
steps.sessions.create: Click New Session, choose a class, set the date and time, then start the session.
steps.sessions.qr: Display this QR code on your projector. Students scan it with their phones to mark attendance.
steps.sessions.close: When class ends, click Close Session to stop new scans.
steps.profile: Your profile page shows your account details.
